detail: Branch qa/exploratory-e2e-2026-09-18 cut from main 44be1f20 (tree equal to origin/main). Route inventory derived from App.tsx: 36 appRoutes + 31 managementRoutes + 2 auth = 69 declared. quality_gate 43 guards passed. Homelab http://testlookup.local live, verified by body not status.
make dev fails: a permission-locked pytest scratch dir (.pytest_cache_t0 / .pytest-cache-m10) is matched by no .dockerignore pattern, so the image build's context walk dies on a stat.
Reproduced independently with a direct docker build of mcp/ (exit 12). CRLF-dockerignore hypothesis tested on a synthetic LF/CRLF pair and DISPROVED - podman strips the carriage return.

probe-route-sweep.spec.ts sweeps /failure-analysis, probe-exploratory.spec.ts sweeps /tests and /flaky - none is a declared route, so the SPA catch-all sends all three to /overview and the sweeps assert against the dashboard.
Confirmed live against http://testlookup.local: final pathname after navigating to /failure-analysis is /overview.

Guard repo.dockerignore-covers-pytest-scratch (quality-gate job, runs in CI) + 4 self-tests. Guard mutation-verified against the historical three-spelling pattern set; self-tests mutation-verified by deleting the working-tree scan.

frontend/src/App.routeTargets.test.ts (frontend-test job, runs in CI) cross-checks every probe spec's route literals against App.tsx. Mutation-verified with a DIFFERENT typo (/flakycoach) than the original defect.
